semantic_checks.explanation: The policy definition of a hospital requires registration under the Clinical Establishments Act or compliance with specific minimum criteria including nursing staff, bed count, and operation theatre.
The policy defines hospitalization as admission for a minimum of 24 consecutive hours; the 96-hour admission exceeds this requirement.
The policy covers hospitalization in any hospital in India, and the provided excerpts do not specify different reimbursement rates for non-network providers.
The case facts do not provide evidence of the hospital's registration status or its compliance with the minimum criteria defined in the policy.
The policy limits medical practitioner and surgeon fees to 25% of the sum insured (125,000 INR), and the claim of 20,000 INR is within this limit.
The policy limits expenses for medicines and diagnostics to 40% of the sum insured (200,000 INR), and the claim of 40,000 INR is within this limit.
